title: OP Donate Stealer
features:
OP Donate Stealer [Mobile Compatible]
​The only tool that successfully intercepts donations and works natively on mobile devices.
​How to use:
​Execute the script.
​Open the donation menu in-game.
​Close the menu immediately.
​Check the script GUI: you will see a status message indicating the donation has been intercepted, showing the exact name of the donation item.
​Once you see the item name in the GUI, click the "Start" button to complete the process.
​Note: The script works only in games with weak protection. If the GUI doesn't display the donation item name, the game's protection is likely too strong for this method.
